mapper.select: select orderId, id, postCode, imp_uid, address1, address2, address3, phone, email, orderPrice, charge, state as o_state, regDate, cancelPrice from orderitem where 1 = 1 and id = #{id} order by regDate

select o.orderId, o.id, o.postCode, o.imp_uid, o.address1, o.address2, o.address3, o.phone, o.email, o.orderPrice, o.charge, o.state as o_state, o.regDate, o.cancelPrice, d.oino, d.orderId, d.ino, d.id, d.quantity, d.price, d.state as d_state, d.imp_uid, d.oino, d.regDate, d.updateDate, a.attachId, a.ino, a.filePath, a.fileName, a.fileType, i.ino, i.category, i.name, i.price, i.amount, i.discount, i.content, i.regDate from orderitem o left outer join orderdetail d on o.orderid = d.orderid left outer join ( select attachid, ino, filepath, filename, filetype from attach where 1 = 1 and lower(filename) like 'main%' OR upper(filename) like 'main%' ) a on d.ino = a.ino left outer join item i on i.ino = d.ino where 1 = 1 and o.orderId = #{orderId} order by o.regDate, d.oino DESC
select * from orderdetail where 1 = 1 and oino = #{oino}
mapper.insert: insert into orderitem(orderId, id, postCode, address1, address2, address3, orderPrice, charge, imp_uid, phone, email) values(#{orderId, jdbcType = VARCHAR}, #{id}, #{postCode}, #{address1}, #{address2}, #{address3}, #{orderPrice}, #{charge}, #{imp_uid}, #{phone}, #{email})

select nvl(max(oino), 0) + 1 from orderdetail
INSERT ALL
into orderdetail(oino, orderId, ino, id, price, quantity, imp_uid) values (#{oino} + #{index}, #{item.orderId}, #{item.ino}, #{item.id}, #{item.price}, #{item.quantity}, #{item.imp_uid})
mapper.update: update orderdetail set state = #{state}, updateDate = sysdate where 1 = 1 and oino = #{oino}
